knowledge:
- key_parameters: con=The path or connection to the input BEDPE file ;; format=The format of the input file, typically "bedpe" ;; txdb=A TxDb object (e.g., TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene) used to define gene promoter regions for annotation ;; orgDb=An OrgDb object (e.g., org.Hs.eg.db) used to map gene IDs to symbols and perform enrichment analysis ;; upstream=The number of base pairs upstream of the TSS to define promoter regions (e.g., 2000) ;; downstream=The number of base pairs downstream of the TSS to define promoter regions (e.g., 500)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have chromatin interaction data (such as Hi-C or ChIA-PET loops) in BEDPE format and want to identify high-order genomic interaction hubs (nodes) and analyze their functional enrichment.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the genome build of the input BEDPE file matches the genome build of the TxDb and OrgDb annotation packages used (e.g., hg19).

workflows.name: detect_and_analyze_interaction_nodes
workflows.intent: Import chromatin interactions, detect interaction nodes, annotate them with gene promoters, and perform Gene Ontology enrichment analysis.
input: WT.2.bedpe (chromatin interaction loops in BEDPE format)
workflows.stages: 1. Import chromatin interactions from a BEDPE file ;; 2. Detect genomic interaction nodes ;; 3. Annotate node regions with gene promoters ;; 4. Perform Gene Ontology enrichment analysis
workflows.code:
library(GenomicInteractionNodes)
library(rtracklayer)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene) ## for human hg19
library(org.Hs.eg.db) ## used to convert gene_id to gene_symbol
library(GO.db) ## used for enrichment analysis

## import the interactions from bedpe file
p <- system.file("extdata", "WT.2.bedpe",
                 package = "GenomicInteractionNodes")
#### please try to replace the connection to your file path
interactions <- import(con=p, format="bedpe")

## define the nodes
nodes <- detectNodes(interactions)
names(nodes)
lapply(nodes, head, n=2)

## annotate the nodes by gene promoters
node_regions <- nodes$node_regions
node_regions <- annotateNodes(node_regions,
                        txdb=TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene,
                        orgDb=org.Hs.eg.db,
                        upstream=2000, downstream=500)
head(node_regions, n=2)

## Gene Ontology enrichment analysis
enrich <- enrichmentAnalysis(node_regions, orgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
names(enrich$enriched)
names(enrich$enriched_in_compound)
res <- enrich$enriched$BP
res <- res[order(res$fdr), ]
head(res, n=2)
